2. Fixed the problem that the declared items disappeared when the items were declared to the headquarters and arrived at the base because of pressing the enter of the keyboard.
3. Solve the problem that some steam achievements cannot be triggered.
4. Solve the problem that you can't fight and loot in the battle of transport line.

6. Fixed the problem that city facilities could not be repaired after being destroyed.

9.Modified the problem that the first level of the expeditionary force bathhouse can not be developed

11.Modified the names of achievements

14.Adjusted the properties of anti-tank guns, and enhanced the properties of German PAK40 guns appropriately
15.Modified the bug that the population of Sherman tank is 16 after customization.

notes.title: EA release in February 2023
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41228489/6665c613d8e97824990bf44c1938daceff2a5a93.png
We are very sorry to inform all commanders that several core employees of the development studio of "Heavyarms Assemble:WWII" have recently been infected with the New Crown virus（COVID-19）, which has greatly affected our development process, and we are just now getting back to work and are in full production. The game will be delayed a few days from its original release in mid-January '23, and the EA version will be available in early February.
